monsters.ability: When you Spin me, if my Attack would kill you, I Flee and lose 1 Attack
monsters.defined: After every On Spin effect, if you are facing me and I am not silenced, look at the Take button's damage. That includes Block (Stone Wall included), Rust, pierce, and Double Buckler if it would halve an even Attack. Do not spend those items. A Healing Potion does not count as surviving. If that damage would leave you at 0 HP, I do not hit you. My Attack goes down by 1, not below 0, and stays down on this copy. Then Flee: I stay on the wheel, and the wheel spins at random. If that spin lands on me and Take would still drop you to 0, I do it again until a landing would leave you at 1 HP or more. Ball and Chain stops the Flee. I still lose the 1 Attack, and the fight stays open so you can play cards. Take uses the new Attack. Quiet Bell turns the check off. Attack I already lost stays lost.

poc.notes: Vanilla ATK/HP plus one BLK, one ATK-with-choice, one ATK-with-condition. No neighbors, no draft, no defeat-on-use.

rulings.rule: SP-06: Hovering any monster on the wheel (face, slice, or card) shows its stats and ability during ready, draft, fighting, and slaying. Keyword tooltips have a readable minimum size and open on click or tap as well as hover.

SP-10: Dialogue types left to right. Click-to-continue shows a blinking next cue; autoplay does not. Space or Enter advances. The talk box reserves choice-button height so it does not jump when options appear.

SP-12: Tutorial empty slices draw as closed placeholders. The landing marker stays at the bottom and is larger. The tutorial dim lifts while a combat effect plays. Move arrows sit farther from the rim and hearts. Slice hover highlights the whole seat including hearts. After a neighbor hole, the facing monster stays at the landing point.

SP-13: Draft item hover floats below the draft box and never covers the other choice. Opening loot shows remaining sack icons, one per monster that still grants a pick (six on a six-seat adventure open).

Web music must keep playing for the current bed. First gesture, focus, visibility, device change, stream finished, and a 0.45s silence watchdog all resume the AudioContext and restart that bed. Pause Master is the umbrella bus; keyboard steps are 5, page steps are 10. Cabin radio stays the per-bus control. No card text change.
Gameplay arrows ← → ↔ are bundled glyphs. Catalog and board copy stay locked as Nathan saved them. The text audit flags a missing_glyph when the font stack cannot draw those characters.

Cabin rooms clip to the designed 1680×1040 frame, centered, so a wide window does not show the next room. Combat mirrors Sprout around the live viewport width and clamps both actors on screen. Shot sizes: 1280×800, 1920×1080, 2560×1080, 3440×1440.
When resolving enemy ATK vs BLK, leftover damage floors at 0. Sheet does not say. POC uses max(0, enemy_atk - blk).
Function Flow Resolve Combat step 4: after you kill them with items OR survive their hit, the slice is removed. POC follows that: not a multi-round HP slog.
Place Starters: four starter-rarity monsters auto-seat at N, E, S, W. Four starter items (always including Smoke Bomb) drop into the hotbar. Player does not click starter seats.

Mill gate: mystery silhouette, item shown, matching-tier threat. Take the relic to slam the door open, reveal the monster, then click an empty alcove. Three passes. After the last pass, remaining alcoves and relics auto-fill. Combat never starts with empty alcoves. Packs still roll 40/35/25; item matches monster tier.
Sai alternates 2 and 4 each time any item is used. Keeps its number between fights; back to 2 each new dungeon. Deals the current value, then the flip applies to later cards.
Knucklers is 7 minus unspent items in hand, live on item use. Not locked at combat start.
Spiked Flail is ATK 2 + 1 per HP-loss event this dungeon (any amount in one hit counts as one). Not kills.

Four starter-rarity monsters. Four starter items: one is always Smoke Bomb, then three more starter-rarity items. Draft is mystery-gate packs until the wheel is full, with three passes then auto-fill.
Hornet Swarm and Spider Queen resolve two separate swings. Block is spent on the first swing (ATK 2 vs BLK 2 blocks the first and leaves BLK 0; the second swing deals 2).

SP-03: Undo must kill wheel recenter and slash tweens without leaving a hung await. Busy flags (_walker_busy, _move_busy, wheel_view.busy, _flushing_holes) clear on restore. Default: in-flight item/move coroutines check _undo_stale and stop. A 500-event session log (spin, item use, undo, scene, audio start/stop, errors) is attached to every F2 / playtest_inbox payload.

SP-07: Quiet Bell silences only the facing seat (seat_uid), not every copy of that card id. Silence lasts the rest of this dungeon on that seat. A later Dire Wolf is not silenced. Locked flow still says owner id; this ruling overrides it. Default: printed ATK/HP after silence, same as before.

SP-08: Echo Bell copies the last item you used this dungeon, including Keep uses (Throwing Knife nick). Record last-used on use, not on discard. Echo is still used up even if the original had Keep. Default: Echo looks like the card (Throwing Knife), not only the nick number.

SP-01. Player-facing title is Spinheritance. title.win is exactly: Victory! You made it out - now time to check out Grandpa's trophy collection back at the Cabin. Repo name, X-Swipe-Playtest headers, and internal ids stay.

SP-09. The menu shows the rocking hero so worn gear is visible. A haul, or a key ring already seen, unlocks every cabin room in the live save. Sleep on the web build shows the existing cannot-sleep line and a click dismisses it. The journal lists only monsters met and items seen in this save. The cat idle bobs. The telescope opens a dialog. Invert scroll defaults off.

SP-14. If this resolve costs the player HP and the monster is still up, the banner reads Escaped. A kill still reads SLAIN. A full block does not read SLAIN. The card keyword stays Defeated. Losing HP flashes, shakes the screen, and plays the existing hurt sound.

SP-15. Item and monster tier metals are bronze, silver, and gold. Choice items show a corner badge of the option numbers (Throwing Knife 3 / 1, Net 1 / 2 / 3). A card not yet in the trophy cabinet shows a New! corner badge instead of a center glimmer.

SP-16. Gelatinous Cube: When you Spin me, feed me one of two items. The Boot: Defeat an enemy with fewer HP than you (not equal). The comparison stays strict less-than. Commander: the first time they are Defeated they Flee and the wheel Spins at random; Flee does not remove them. Wheel name tags clear the stat icons.
